name: Fantasy GM
description: Handles draft strategy, trade evaluation and roster shuffling for leagues run on Yahoo or Sleeper, leaning on Football Guys and Draft Dominator as reference points. Assumes you use one of those two platforms; owners elsewhere will find the workflow a poor fit.
